tags.character: isolated island site outside Triton Bay proper, northwest of Aiduma; rubble/hard coral habitat; type locality area for Paracheilinus nursalim flasher wrasse displaying at DUSK (not dawn)

tags.character: open blue water bagan fishing platform in Kaimana Bay; whale sharks are predominantly juvenile/sub-adult (avg. ~4.6m +/- 2m per Kaimana ISRA survey), not routinely full-grown adults
tags.seasonal: October to April, best at new moon / dark-moon periods; encounters most reliable 6:30-9:00am per operator reports
tags.notes: QA 2026-07-07 re-audit: corrected 'adults and juveniles ... stands apart from other bagan sites' claim -- the Kaimana Important Shark and Ray Area (ISRA) scientific survey (sharkrayareas.org) documents the local population as majority juvenile/sub-adult, average total length ~4.6m. This does not support a claim of routine full-size adult encounters. Confirmed whale sharks are seen AT the bagan platforms specifically, not incidentally at other Triton Bay reef/wall sites.

tags.character: wall dive at Namatota Island (regional operators call it 'Namatota Wall'), rare shrimps/crabs/nudibranchs/gobies; whale sharks are seen at nearby bagan platforms, not routinely inside the wall/channel itself
tags.note: One of Triton Bay's best sites alongside Aquarium, Little Komodo, Bo's Rainbow
tags.notes: QA 2026-07-07 re-audit: corrected claim that whale sharks 'sometimes appear in the channel itself' -- divehappy.com's on-the-ground operator interview describes Namatota Wall as a diving 'consolation' when whale sharks (seen at nearby bagans) don't show, i.e. the wall and the bagan encounters are distinct experiences. Added confirmed rare macro life (shrimps, crabs, nudibranchs, gobies) from xray-mag.com.
